Class EasyXT

  • java.lang.Object
    • ch.epfl.biop.imaris.EasyXT

  • public class EasyXT
extends Object
    Main EasyXT Static class
    Author:
    Olivier Burri, Nicolas Chiaruttini, Romain Guiet This is the main static class you should access when you want to interact with Imaris.

    • Nested Class Summary

      Nested Classes 
      Modifier and Type Class and Description
      static class  EasyXT.Dataset
      This sublass deals with direct Imaris Datasets, not surface-based datasets This includes methods to transfer, convert and move datasets around Imaris and Fiji
      static class  EasyXT.Files
      This subclass contains methods to open images in Imaris There are also methods to find all the demo Images from Imaris
      static class  EasyXT.Samples
      This Class takes care of downloading and using sample files
      static class  EasyXT.Scene
      This class handles all queries to the surpass scene and to its related Items Method to find spots, surfaces, groups, or arbitrary objects are found inside Methods to get or set item names
      static class  EasyXT.Spots
      This class contains all methods directly related to spots.
      static class  EasyXT.Stats
      This class handles getting statistics from Imaris as well as sending statistics back to Imaris
      static class  EasyXT.Surfaces
      This class contains all methods directly related to surfaces.
      static class  EasyXT.Tracks
      This class contains methods directly related to Surface and Spots tracking.

      This internal class contains methods that normally do not need to be used and are mostly internal
